newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timbers Oil issues $125 mln 144A debt.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timbers Oil issues $125 mln 144A debt.

text.p: A $125 million debt issue from Cross Timbers Oil Co was priced in the 144A private placement market on Thursday, according to a high-yield syndicate source.
The deal was downsized from $165 million in response to rising borrowing costs in the junk market, the source said. Proceeds will be used to repay outstanding bank debt.
Cross Timbers is engaged in the acquisition, exploitation, and development of oil and gas properties concentrated in Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas, New Mexico and Wyoming.
